The '''1933–34 National Hurling League''' was the seventh edition of the [[National Hurling League]], which ran from 15 October 1933 until 25 March 1934.

[[Limerick GAA|Limerick]] defeated [[Dublin GAA|Dublin]] by 3-6 to 3-3 in the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|title=National Hurling League Results 1925-2009|publisher=Hogan Stand|accessdate=18 April 2011|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100805063526/http://www.hoganstand.com/general/leagues/nhlrecords.aspx|archive-date=2010-08-05|url-status=dead}}</ref>

Limerick also won the [[All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|All-Ireland Championship]] in [[1934 All-Ireland Senior Hurling Championship|1934]], the third time that a team completed the [[The Double (Gaelic games)#National League-All-Ireland double|league-championship double]].
